title: Dataset of emotion recognition using validated video stimuli with large-scale behavioral survey and MEG recordings
description: This dataset comprises magnetoencephalography (MEG) recordings from 23 participants viewing 40 validated emotional video stimuli, complemented by a large-scale behavioral survey (500 participants) and head digitization data. The dataset provides multi-faceted emotion annotations including Self-Assessment Manikin (SAM) ratings for valence and arousal, discrete emotion categories (PrEmo), and temporal scene selections, enabling investigation of emotion-specific neural signal patterns for brain signal-based emotion recognition research.
methods_description: MEG neural recordings were acquired from 23 participants during viewing of 40 validated video clips designed to induce different emotional states. Head position information including 3D spatial coordinates for anatomical landmarks and Head Position Indicator (HPI) coils was measured prior to each recording session. Emotional responses were assessed using Self-Assessment Manikin (SAM) for valence and arousal, discrete emotion categories (PrEmo), and temporal highlight scene selections. A parallel online survey collected subjective emotional assessments from 500 participants for the same video stimuli. This dataset is derived from OpenNeuro dataset ds007640 (v1.0.1).
